mechanism_narrative: A declining federal funds rate trend consistently signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing the cost of capital and boosting equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 5.0% for three consecutive months, it indicates a weakening labor market that triggers central bank easing, which subsequently lifts equity prices, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0% for three consecutive months, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03 in a 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in the federal funds rate and a contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a monetary policy response to weakening demand, which typically precedes a market rebound as the Fed's actions become effective, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
regime_hint: monetary policy response to demand contraction
failure_condition: The interaction between FEDFUNDS decline and RSAFS contraction fails to predict positive returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO), the market anticipates a slowdown in economic activity, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days as investors price in recession risks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO is declining, or the Rank IC over 3-year windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS is rising, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) falls below its 12-month moving average, it signals weakening consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days as the market prices in reduced corporate revenue growth.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when RSAFS < 12-month MA, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in industrial production (INDPRO) and a contraction in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) signals a broad-based economic slowdown, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as the market prices in recession risks.
failure_condition: The joint decline of INDPRO and RSAFS fails to predict negative returns in more than 60% of cases over a 3-year rolling window, or the Rank IC is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 2.5%, it signals a tightening monetary policy stance that increases borrowing costs and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 2.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.03.
